title: Average Rate of Increase in Property Tax for Private Residential Properties and Proposal to Reduce These for Properties Occupied by Elderly Retirees
what_it_is: Average Rate of Increase in Property Tax for Private Residential Properties and Proposal to Reduce These for Properties Occupied by Elderly Retirees

sections.label: Property tax as wealth tax
sections.summary: Property tax is the primary means of taxing wealth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Property tax, or PT, is our primary means of taxing wealth.

sections.label: Higher PT rates announced
sections.summary: Budget 2022 announced raised PT rates for higher-end owner-occupied residential properties with AVs above $30,000 in 2023 and 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As announced in Budget 2022, PT rates have been raised for higher-end owner-occupied residential properties, with AVs above $30,000 in 2023 and 2024.

sections.label: Median PT growth rate
sections.summary: Median PT for owner-occupied private residential properties grew at a CAGR of around 7% from 2020 to 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The median PT for owner-occupied private residential properties in Singapore, grew at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of around 7% from 2020 to 2023.

sections.label: IRAS computing annual value
sections.summary: IRAS generally excludes very high and outlier rentals when computing AV.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The way that IRAS goes about computing AV is that they will, generally, exclude very high and outlier rentals that the properties may fetch.

sections.label: Assets as wealth proxy
sections.summary: Property is an asset, and a person's assets are a proxy measurement of the person's wealth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Property is an asset, and I hope Mr Lim agrees with me on that.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, I think we do need to consider that a person's assets are a proxy measurement of the person's wealth.

sections.label: Helping retirees beyond property tax
sections.summary: Retirees who cannot earn much income should be helped in other ways, not through lower PT, such as age-based polyclinic subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We do understand that they are retirees, they may not be able to earn a lot of income because they are not working.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, the way to help them is not to have a lower PT, because that is something that we need to put in place as part of our fair and progressive tax system, but to find other ways of helping them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: In our polyclinics, for example, we do not means test based on your property type, but when you go to a polyclinic, we look at your age and seniors do receive additional subsidies.
